businesses.business: wireless broadband devices and cloud management

offering_description.value: Designs wireless broadband devices such as 5G mobile hotspots, fixed wireless routers and gateways, plus cloud software for managing them. Sells to wireless carriers, enterprises and service providers, with devices built by contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: 5G fixed wireless access routers and gateways; mobile hotspots; indoor and outdoor wireless routers; USB modems

primary_services.value: cloud-based device management software subscriptions; telematics and fleet management; device security and support services

customer_segment.value: B2B: wireless carriers, internet service providers, enterprises, and distributors/resellers; B2G: government and public safety agencies; B2C: consumers buying hotspots through carrier and retail channels

end_markets.value: telecommunications; enterprise networking; fleet and transportation; public safety; broadband internet access

revenue_model.value: product sales: wireless broadband devices sold to carriers, distributors and enterprises; subscription: cloud management and telematics software subscriptions; service fees: managed services and support

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs devices and software, outsources manufacturing to contract manufacturers, sells to carriers and enterprises; software / platform: cloud platform for device and fleet management sold by subscription

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada mainly, with some sales in Europe and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: wireless broadband hardware, cloud management software and telematics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: major wireless carriers and large enterprise accounts; distributors / dealers: distributors and value-added resellers; third-party retail: carrier and retail stores for hotspots
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: wireless devices need FCC certification and carrier approval, export, data privacy and security rules apply

notes: Inseego sold its telematics business in 2024 to Ctrack; the telematics and fleet items may be outdated. Mix of carrier versus enterprise sales is uncertain.
